prompt: The oldest extant football team in Italy plays in a stadium.   The stadium is named after a person.   Who was the emperor of China when that person was 5 years old?
answer: The oldest extant Italian football team is **Genoa CFC**, which plays at **Stadio Luigi Ferraris**. Luigi Ferraris was born in **1887**, so when he was five—around **1892**—the emperor of China was the **Guangxu Emperor** (reigned 1875–1908).
